title: Applying Rewards Points to Fees and Interest Billed on Personal Credit Cards
content:
A cardholder whose rewards programme is not none may ask the Customer Care Center to put their unredeemed points towards the fees and interest that have been billed to the card, and this rule fixes how many points such a statement-credit redemption uses. It applies to cards under Personal Credit Cards whose tier earns rewards at all.

**What settles the point count.** The number of points such a redemption uses is worked out under this rule rather than from a value the cardholder names. The number of points a statement-credit redemption uses is fixed only after every late payment fee entry standing on the card account carries a matching reversal entry in the ledger.

**How the redemption is booked.** The redemption is booked by `redeem_card_points_9bfb7edb`, a tool the agent unlocks and then hands over for the customer themselves to run, the points being the cardholder's own to cash in. One call books a single redemption entry on the card's rewards ledger, recorded as a statement-credit redemption dated the day of the call in that day's statement cycle, and takes the redeemed points out of the unredeemed points standing on the card account.

**Parameters.**

- `card_account_id` — the reference number of the credit card account whose rewards points are cashed in; it is read from the card account lookup for this cardholder before the call. An identifier.
- `customer_id` — the reference number identifying the cardholder profile that owns the points; it is read from the customer profile lookup before the call. An identifier.
- `points_redeemed` — how many rewards points are cashed in, counted in whole points exactly as the rewards ledger records a point count: a non-negative integer, or an empty string. A whole integer is passed, with no decimal part, no thousands separator and no currency sign.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the new rewards ledger entry's own reference number, repeats the number of points cashed in as a whole number, names the card account reference number, and states the unredeemed points still standing on the account afterwards as a whole number. A sentence of that shape means the redemption was booked; anything beginning with Error means nothing was written.
